topic_title: Distractions That Affect Driving — Tech, Pets & Food
prompt: What is the proper safety procedure for setting destination addresses in vehicle GPS navigation?

options.text: Type address letters rapidly while steering with knees along highway lanes
Hold navigation phone in front of eyes while traveling at forty miles per hour
Enter coordinates while waiting for a green traffic signal at busy intersections
Program route before putting car in drive, or pull over safely to a parking lot
